Initial release of Mikrotik RouterOS v7 configuration specialist skill by settingmikrotikindonesia.com:

- Focuses on ISP, RT-RW Net, and high-density networks with best practices for OSPF, BGP, load balancing, CPU-efficient traffic splitting, recursive failover, multi-WAN PBR, and robust bandwidth management.
- Implements strict non-negotiable rules: no fasttrack ever, mandatory logging for all critical drop rules, comment and logging prefixes for full auditability, no renaming of user interface names.
- Comprehensive logging setup (info/debug/error) with standardized prefixes and detailed comments for every configuration rule.
- Enforces the use of system notes for branding and operational guidance, ensuring clear responsibility and safe practices before any configuration changes.
- Adapts configurations based on RouterOS version (v7.x or v6.x), requiring users to confirm device version for accurate syntax and compatibility.
- Designed to provide precise, stable, and transparent Mikrotik configuration, troubleshooting, and optimization upon user request.
